headline: Araghchi accuses Bibi of dragging US into war to dodge prison
dek: Trump praised Netanyahu as 'strong and courageous', wrote 'Together we will complete this mission', and warned that if Israel elects another leader 'America will have to do this work ourselves, and I am not inclined to do so'. Araghchi: 'Netanyahu is driving America into another war to stay out of…
sources: Donald Trump (Truth Social post, via AP/nocutnews); Abbas Araghchi (X post, via MENAFN/english.nv.ua); IRGC spokesman Hossein Mohebi (via Haaretz)
fault_line: Trump is openly conditioning US protection on keeping Netanyahu in power, 9 days before an Israeli election. Is this election insurance for Bibi — or the on-ramp to a second round of war?

sections.what_happened: Trump praised Netanyahu as 'strong and courageous', wrote 'Together we will complete this mission', and warned that if Israel elects another leader 'America will have to do this work ourselves, and I am not inclined to do so'. Araghchi: 'Netanyahu is driving America into another war to stay out of jail... Last time you wanted to finish the job, Iran emerged even stronger... We have unfinished jobs too.' Mohebi: any attack on Iran's energy infrastructure would turn Israel into 'scorched earth' and force its residents to relocate to the Sinai Desert.
sections.what_verified: AP (via nocutnews), MENAFM (MENAFN), Haaretz, english.nv.ua, Gulf News analysis. Context: CNN Oct 19 (covered 1800-02) — US strike plans incl. GBU-43/B MOAB vs Iranian energy/nuclear sites; Axios — Trump-Netanyahu Oct 14 war-planning discussion.
sections.what_disputed: No new offensive announced by Washington or Jerusalem. Trump previously said no US attack before Nov 3 midterms. White House disputed Axios account of war-planning talks. TRAP: MENAFN text says Netanyahu 'wanted by the International Court of Justice since 2024' — WRONG COURT; the ICC (International Criminal Court) issued warrants Nov 2024. Do not cite the ICJ version.
sections.why_matters: Araghchi's charge, stated plainly: Netanyahu is manufacturing another war to stay out of prison. Trump, meanwhile, is telling Israeli voters that keeping Bibi in office is the price of American protection. Iran's answer: touch our energy sites and we turn Israel to scorched earth.
sections.context: Background: US-Israel-Iran threat axis — Trump endorses Netanyahu 9 days before Israeli election; Araghchi accuses Bibi of dragging US into war to dodge prison; IRGC warns 'scorched earth' (extends 1800-02, 1800-06)

totw_analysis: Our read: Araghchi's charge, stated plainly: Netanyahu is manufacturing another war to stay out of prison. Trump, meanwhile, is telling Israeli voters that keeping Bibi in office is the price of American protection. Iran's answer: touch our energy sites and we turn Israel to scorched earth. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Trump is openly conditioning US protection on keeping Netanyahu in power, 9 days before an Israeli election. Is this election insurance for Bibi — or the on-ramp to a second round of war?
